title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: Archived release of the IELTS API source code and datasets. Cite this record, or the version-specific DOI, when you use the API or the datasets in research. Version 1.3 adds the definitional lexical network (25,191 directed cross-reference edges over 4,174 Cambridge headwords, with degree, component and hub statistics) and seeded, reproducible vocabulary drills (multiple-choice definition cloze and word-definition matching) generated from the published glosses.
